title: Law on Medicinal Resources No. 55/NA; dated 28 June 2024.
text:
To establish the principles, regulations, and measures for the management and monitoring of medicinal resources to ensure their effective and efficient conservation, development, and utilization. This aims to protect medicinal resources from depletion and extinction, promote their sustainable use and abundance, ensure the availability of safe and high-quality medicinal materials for healthcare and treatment, improve public health and well-being, support the development of export products, facilitate regional and international integration, and contribute to national protection and sustainable development.
